name: Blackjack 21 Big Cards Offline
description:
Offline blackjack 21 with big, easy-to-read cards and a twist: you play against four opponents and the dealer at a five-seat table, and the best hand sweeps every chip the losers left behind. No wifi needed, no ads, no real money.

BIG CARDS, EASY TO READ
Built for people who want to see the game. Large cards, a big balance, oversized chips and buttons, and a table that stays full size all the way through the hand. No squinting, no pinch-zoom. Blackjack you can play on a phone without glasses.

PLAY REAL BLACKJACK 21
Hit, stand, double down, split, surrender and insurance, with blackjack paying 3:2, the dealer standing on 17 and a six-deck shoe. Classic Vegas casino rules.

BEAT THE TABLE, NOT JUST THE DEALER
Four other players sit at the table with you. Beat the dealer to keep your bet, then beat the table to sweep the pot. Every hand is a race to 21 against five hands, not one.

OFFLINE BLACKJACK, ANYWHERE
No internet, no mobile data, no problem. Play blackjack on a plane, on the train or with no wifi. Daily chips, a play-day streak bonus and a rebuy when you run low keep the game going.

LEARN BLACKJACK STRATEGY
Your first three hands are coached one lesson at a time: how to play a hand, how to read the dealer's up-card, then the bigger moves and the sweep pot. A full "How to play" guide with card values, every move, dealer rules and payouts is always one tap away. A clear table and slow-paced dealing make this a good blackjack trainer for beginners and a fast game for regulars.

HEAR EVERY HAND
The dealer calls its total as it plays, your hand total is read aloud when the turn reaches you, and every result is spoken. Turn the voice off any time and keep the sound effects.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS
Invite friends with one WhatsApp link, sit at the same table, and race them on hourly, daily and all-time leaderboards. Sign in with Google to keep your chips, friends and standings across devices, or play as a guest.

FREE TO PLAY
Free chips every day, no purchases, no ads. Free blackjack, no real money.

Also called 21, twenty-one, black jack or pontoon, this is the classic casino card game with big cards and a full table.

This game is intended for an adult audience and does not offer real money gambling or any opportunities to win real money or prizes. Practice or success at social casino gaming does not imply future success at real money gambling.
